description: This file defines the 'Incrementor' class, a utility class used to manage a counter with a maximum limit, capable of triggering a callback or exception when the limit is reached. It provides methods to increment, reset, and configure the counter, with support for custom behavior at counter exhaustion.

classes.description: Utility class to manage a counter with a maximum limit, trigger callback or exception upon reaching the limit.

classes.description: Interface for callback to be triggered when the maximum count is exceeded.
